
gpu/gpu-dma-rdloop
R shape phase, eight calls back to back (cycles; st: GPUSTAT's top byte straight after the transfer, hex): ds1 DrawSync(0) after
the last read, wr GP1(04h)=0 + GP0(C0h)'s three words, ds2 DrawSync(0), b27 GP1(04h)=3 to GPUSTAT bit 27, set DPCR + CHCR2 +
MADR2 + BCR2, dma CHCR2's store to bit 24 clear. T shape: the eight calls' total. No assertions.
